name: Defensepenetration
markup: The spell ignores some of the target's {STAT_defense} when determining the damage dealt.

name: Potencyhealth
markup: Part of the spell's potency is based on the caster's Current {STAT_health} instead of {STAT_intelligence}.

name: Castsonextraenemy
markup: The spell is cast on an additional creature.

name: Caststwice
markup: Creature has a chance to cast the spell an additional time.

name: Shared
markup: At the start of battle, your other creatures gain an [temporary]Ethereal copy of the Spell Gem, but it has only 1 {STAT_charge}.

name: Morecharges
markup: The Spell Gem has additional {STAT_charges}.

name: Duration
markup: Increases the duration of buffs granted and debuffs afflicted by the Spell Gem.

name: Increaseddamage
markup: The spell deals additional damage.

name: Increasedhealing
markup: The spell heals for a greater amount.

name: Statpotency
markup: The spell increases and decreases stats by a greater amount.

name: Swapchaos
markup: The Spell Gem's class is changed to {CLASS_Chaos}.

name: Swapdeath
markup: The Spell Gem's class is changed to {CLASS_Death}.

name: Swaplife
markup: The Spell Gem's class is changed to {CLASS_Life}.

name: Swapsorcery
markup: The Spell Gem's class is changed to {CLASS_Sorcery}.

name: Swapnature
markup: The Spell Gem's class is changed to {CLASS_Nature}.

name: Defendafter
markup: Creature has a chance to {ACTION_defend} after it casts the spell.

name: Provokeafter
markup: Creature has a chance to {ACTION_provoke} after it casts the spell.

name: Attackafter
markup: Creature has a chance to {ACTION_attack} a random enemy after it casts the spell.

name: Magnetic
markup: The spell's potency is increased by 15% for each of the same Spell Gem equipped by your party.

name: Cascading
markup: The spell's potency is increased by 5% for each {STAT_charge} the Spell Gem is missing.

name: Singular
markup: The spell's potency is increased by 50% for each empty Spell Gem slot the creature has.

name: Potencydefense
markup: Part of the spell's potency is based on the caster's {STAT_defense} instead of {STAT_intelligence}.

name: Potencyspeed
markup: Part of the spell's potency is based on the caster's {STAT_speed} instead of {STAT_intelligence}.

name: Potencyattack
markup: Part of the spell's potency is based on the caster's {STAT_attack} instead of {STAT_intelligence}.

name: Castonattack
markup: Creature has a chance to cast the spell after it {ACTION_attacks}.

name: Castondefend
markup: Creature has a chance to cast the spell after it {ACTION_defends}.

name: Castonprovoke
markup: Creature has a chance to cast the spell after it {ACTION_provokes}.

name: Castonheal
markup: Creature has a chance to cast the spell after it heals a creature.
